title: Migrate tag-smuggled relations to typed edges
description:
## G-5 (from kb-graph-rag-audit)

After G-4 defines the typed-edge schema, migrate existing colon-prefixed tag relations (supersedes:tsk-0123, depends-on:xyz, etc.) out of the Tags field and into the new edge store.

### Detailed Steps
1. One-time backfill: run ExtractTagRelationships parsing logic over the live corpus to seed the new edge store
2. Stop parsing colon-prefixed tags as relations going forward — they become inert (remain as literal tags only if a human wants them)
3. Add existence validation at write time: reject/flag any edge whose target isn't a real record or page ID (closes the dangling-edge gap in current ExtractTagRelationships)
4. Update Tag Manager / tag-policy validation to no longer reason about "real" vs "pseudo-relation" tags

### Test Plan
- Migration test: backfill against a fixture with supersedes:/depends-on: tags, assert edge set matches what ExtractTagRelationships would produce today
- Validation test: attempt to create edge to nonexistent ID, assert rejection

### Source
Audit: `Data/Pages/audits/kb-graph-rag-audit-10-07-26-00-00-00.md` — G-5
- `MaintenanceAgentServices.cs:1105-1130` (ExtractTagRelationships)
- `MemorySmith.Core/Models/MemoryRecord.cs`

### Sprint Placement: Sprint 3
### Confidence: 80%
